# The crawl plan: written by the owner, kept outside the repository.
# Form: [section] lines and key = value lines; a # starts a comment. Every key has a default, so a key left out takes the spec's value.
# This first version holds the keys the discovery side reads and the file paths. The runner's own keys (ceilings, pacing, disk floors, the breaker,
# the scan and the judge) are added when the runner is built.

[limits]
queue_low = 100             # discovery refills the queue when fewer rows than this are queued
discover_target = 200       # rows one refill adds, at most
queries_per_topic = 3       # queries made from a topic
queued_total = 20000        # rows with status queued
queued_per_domain = 50

[sources]
openalex = on
arxiv = on
wikipedia = on
web_search = off            # on, or duckduckgo, to use it; its terms are unresolved, so it stays off until the owner turns it on
wander_share = 0.2          # share of a batch taken from citation links, not from topic queries
wander_depth = 2            # citation steps from a topic's own results
wander_per_work = 5         # works taken from one kept work
gap_openalex_s = 1          # seconds between requests to a source
gap_arxiv_s = 3
gap_wikipedia_s = 1
gap_web_search_s = 30
web_search_per_day = 20

[files]
topics = ~/.config/knowledge-base/crawl-topics.txt
blacklist = ~/.config/knowledge-base/crawl-blacklist.txt
allow = ~/.config/knowledge-base/crawl-allow.txt
